messages:
emily: Heads-up — I'm syncing the HF manifest for zeta-13b -> s3 mirror and seeing a couple of weird entries in the tokenizer path. checksum mismatch on shard_02.bin. Anyone else hit this? :eyes:

raj: Not on my end. Can you paste the `sha256sum` and the s3 path?

emily: ```
$ sha256sum model/shard_02.bin
9f2b3a1c6d8f4a5e2b7c9d0e1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678  shard_02.bin

hf path: hf://zeta-13b/weights/step-5000/shard_02.bin
s3 path: s3://rw-artifacts/zeta-13b/weights/step-5000/shard_02.bin
```

maria: Looks like the HF manifest entry had a dangling newline char in the `path` field earlier — that can change the computed digest. Try `tr -d '
' < file | sha256sum` before uploading.

emily: Recomputed after stripping newline and now the digest matches the S3 object. Thanks. One more thing: presign URLs for a few manifests are 403'ing when our sync tries to fetch them (GET 403). @buildbot any idea?

buildbot: We rotated the origin role keys yesterday; older presign tokens will fail. If you re-run `artifacts/presign --origin zeta-13b --refresh` it will regen presigns. I can queue it for you.

emily: If we regen presigns mid-rollout, will pinned clients break? We're in the middle of a canary.

oliver: Old presigns remain valid until their TTL. The main risk is our mirror job caching the presigns in the manifest. Suggest: regen presigns + invalidate the `mirror-cache` keys for `zeta-13b/step-5000`. I can run invalidation after regen. :thumbsup:

raj: Also check `manifest.schema_version`. If it's v2 we require `tokenizer_spec` at top-level — missing that makes the ingest fallback path rewrite locations.

emily: Plan: 1) strip newline & re-hash, 2) run presign refresh, 3) oliver invalidate cache, 4) raj verify manifest schema. I'll document steps in the onboarding runbook and ping when done. :white_check_mark:

maria: If you want, I can add a small CI check `ci/weights-verify` that runs `sha256` + manifest schema lint before we mark ingest-ready. I can open a PR later today. :+1:

buildbot: Queued presign refresh for zeta-13b step-5000. Job id: jb-4421. ETA ~3m.

emily: Thanks all — following up with final checks in this thread.
